post.description: Creates a new domain in Resend.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

name.description: The name of the domain you want to create.

region.description: Region where emails will be sent from. Possible values: us-east-1, eu-west-1, sa-east-1, ap-northeast-1.

customReturnPath.description: Subdomain used for Return-Path address (SPF/DMARC/bounces). Defaults to send.

openTracking.description: Track the open rate of each email.

clickTracking.description: Track clicks within each HTML email.

tls.description: TLS mode. Possible values: opportunistic or enforced.

capabilities.description: Domain capabilities object. Include sending (enabled|disabled) and receiving (enabled|disabled). At least one capability should be enabled.

region.description: Region where the domain is hosted.
